cd /workspace && timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,time,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
rng=random.Random(22)
fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':'size','domain':[0,1]} for i in range(4)];K=4;nf=4
preds=[]
for i in range(32):
 refs1=rng.sample([(s,f['name']) for s in range(K) for f in fields],4)
 refs2=rng.sample([(s,f['name']) for s in range(K) for f in fields],4)
 preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':[list(r) for r in refs1]},'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),'right':{'sum':[list(r) for r in refs2]}})
flat_domains=[f['domain'] for s in range(K) for f in fields]
train=[]
for _ in range(10000):
 flat=[rng.choice(d) for d in flat_domains]
 train.append([flat[s*nf:(s+1)*nf] for s in range(K)])
queries=[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'f0'],'prefix':''} for _ in range(64)]
job={'fields':fields,'slots':K,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}
st=time.time();r=compile_job(job);print('one worst eval',time.time()-st,'rules',len(r['rules']))
st=time.time();r2=compile_job(job);print('again',time.time()-st)
PY
